description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecHostRequestEvaluator component in the OpenClaw project, focusing on request validation and decision logic under various security and allowlist conditions.

methods.name: validate request rejects empty command
methods.description: Tests that an empty command in ExecHostRequest results in an invalid request error.

methods.name: evaluate requires prompt on allowlist miss without decision
methods.description: Tests that the evaluator requires a prompt when the allowlist is not satisfied and no decision has been made.

methods.name: evaluate allows allow once decision on allowlist miss
methods.description: Verifies that the evaluator allows an 'allow once' decision when the allowlist is not satisfied.

methods.name: evaluate denies on explicit deny decision
methods.description: Checks that the evaluator correctly denies execution when an explicit deny decision is provided.

methods.name: makeContext
methods.description: Helper function to create various security evaluation contexts for testing.
